title: Keep Office on your Mac for good with this $99.97 lifetime license
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Microsoft Office Home & Business 2021 for Mac is on sale for $99.97 (reg. $219), a one-time payment for lifetime access to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook with no renewals.

Subscription software keeps billing you every year, along with a steady stream of renewal reminders, for apps you already use every day. To get Office without that ongoing cost, consider a lifetime license for Microsoft Office Home & Business 2021 for Mac, on sale for $99.97 (reg. $219). You pay once and keep Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook on your Mac with no recurring charges.

MS Office apps included on your Mac:

  • Word
  • Excel
  • PowerPoint
  • Outlook
  • Teams (basic)
  • OneNote (free version)

That’s basically everything you need to handle work projects, personal tasks, or school assignments like a pro. It’s perfect for students, families, or small business owners who want a dependable, full-featured productivity suite without ongoing costs.

Once you purchase, you’ll get instant delivery of your redemption code via email, along with instructions to activate it. The license connects to your Microsoft Account (not your device), and it works on one Mac for the lifetime of the product. It also comes with updates and free customer service.

Just make sure you redeem the code within 7 days of purchase, and note that this version is not compatible with virtual machines like Parallels Pro.

Skip the subscriptions — get a lifetime license to Microsoft Office Home & Business for Mac 2021 for $99.97.
